rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3BA blastocyst and correctly identifies a loosely grouped ICM and cohesive TE, but it overstates certainty from a single image and includes features not reliably assessable here (uniform zona thinning, intact junctions, no re-collapse/necrosis, granular debris in cavity).
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear progression from baseline prognosis to embryo-quality and lifestyle adjustments; however, the magnitude of the smoking penalty and some fine-tuning adjustments are somewhat speculative.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, single-embryo transfer context, luteal support, and smoking cessation, but includes less guideline-based suggestions such as ERA after one failure, routine antioxidants/vitamin E/L-arginine, and low-dose aspirin framed too broadly for IVF pregnancies.

Provides clear practical steps for current transfer and future planning, especially around smoking cessation and transfer/luteal management, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
